statement.document_title: Where Are All The Data Centers?

from_speaker: Oracle lacks Microsoft or Google’s existing profitable businesses to fall back on
if these data centers are delayed
our_interpretation: This describes Oracle's current financial position. The delay clause explains the claimed vulnerability rather than conditioning the observation on a future delay.
The target is Oracle's latest reported quarter before the post: fiscal Q3 2026, December 1, 2025 through February 28, 2026.
The ordinary reading is that mature businesses provide little growth or comparable financial support, while meaningful growth is confined to OpenAI commitments and loss-making GPU compute.
Existing businesses include established cloud applications as well as on-premises software; they are not restricted to the reporting line named Software.
The statement does not identify a common accounting basis, a margin definition or a GPU product cohort. Those cannot be supplied merely by selecting a convenient evidence source.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable target-period evidence shows mature businesses broadly plateauing without material profitable growth outside the stated AI activities, and establishes a negative 100% GPU-compute margin on the claimed scope and accounting basis.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matching evidence establishes material realized growth and profitability in established businesses outside the named AI activities, or a materially different GPU margin for the same period, product scope and cost definition. A definitive grade requires resolving the unspecified financial basis.
